decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-208 MODIFY already captures the prototype review sequence, including completion of base fabrication after the demonstration.
Sequencing the remaining base fabrication after prototype review does not change the required maintenance or service access.
The platform fabrication sequence does not alter the approved branding or placard details; the source message's separate branding-timing decision is already represented.
The base fabrication sequence does not independently change the visual-identity attributes, and the same message already records deferral and later timing of additional visual refinement.
Completing base fabrication after demonstration review does not change the selected functional components or BOM; the same-message event already handles deferral of decorative LED selection.
The source changes the fabrication sequence, not the finalized system layout, CAD deliverable, or raised-platform geometry.
The base fabrication sequence does not alter the DJ-style control specifications, and the same message already captures the timing of additional control refinement.
The source event's fabrication sequencing does not modify lighting attributes; the same source message already defers decorative lighting through an existing lifecycle Event.
